title: A Political Rebellion in the Rio Grande Valley

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带300张你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个充满活力的、由美丽的50年历史的艺术品组成的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In tomorrow's election, few regions of the country are expected to swing harder away from President Trump and toward Democrats than the Rio Grande Valley of Texas,
sentences.zh: 在明天的选举中，预计全国很少有地区会像得克萨斯州的格兰德河谷那样，大幅度撤回对特朗普总统的支持并转向民主党，

sentences.en: where life has been transformed by the president's crackdown on immigration.
sentences.zh: 那里的生活因总统对移民的严厉打击而发生了天翻地覆的变化。

sentences.en: For the past year, my colleague, Daily producer Lindsay Garrison, has been reporting on that shift and the unlikely group leading the charge.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，我的同事、《每日新闻》制作人林赛·加里森一直在报道这种转变以及引领这场变革的意想不到的群体。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月2日，星期一。

sentences.en: When the raids first started in the Rio Grande Valley in early 2025, people were confused.
sentences.zh: 2025年初格兰德河谷首次开始突袭搜查时，人们感到很困惑。

sentences.en: Sure, some people with criminal records were getting picked up, but so were people who weren't criminals.
sentences.zh: 当然，一些有犯罪记录的人被抓了，但也有一些没有犯罪的人被抓了。

sentences.en: People who had lived along this stretch of land near the Mexican border for years.
sentences.zh: 那些在墨西哥边境附近的这片土地上生活了多年的人。

sentences.en: So people were scared.
sentences.zh: 所以人们感到害怕。

sentences.en: Some stopped going to work or going to church.
sentences.zh: 有些人不再去上班或去教堂。

sentences.en: And then, ICE agents started showing up at job sites.
sentences.zh: 然后，美国移民和海关执法局的特工开始出现在工作场所。

sentences.en: Videos began to circulate.
sentences.zh: 视频开始流传。

sentences.en: Some showing an ICE agent tapping a worker on the back, while he and his crew were in the middle of laying a concrete driveway.
sentences.zh: 其中一些显示，当一名工人与他的团队正在铺设混凝土车道时，一名移民执法局特工拍了拍他的后背。

sentences.en: Continuing to work until the moment they were handcuffed, with puzzled looks on their faces.
sentences.zh: 他们继续工作，直到被戴上手铐的那一刻，脸上带着困惑的表情。

sentences.en: But compared to many places across the country, the raids and the reaction to them seemed to be happening fairly quietly.
sentences.zh: 但与全国许多地方相比，突袭行动以及对此的反应似乎相当平静地进行着。

sentences.en: And then one day, someone spoke out.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，有人发声了。

sentences.en: What's going on, Rio Grande Valley?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事，格兰德河谷？

sentences.en: It's Mario Guerrero here.
sentences.zh: 我是马里奥·格雷罗。

sentences.en: A developer named Mario Guerrero posted a video sounding the alarm.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫马里奥·格雷罗的开发商发布了一段发出警报的视频。

sentences.en: Because this is going to ruin our economy.
sentences.zh: 因为这将毁了我们的经济。

sentences.en: It's going to ruin the housing market.
sentences.zh: 这将毁了房地产市场。

sentences.en: The American dream.
sentences.zh: 美国梦。

sentences.en: At that time, it was the only thing I'd seen like it.
sentences.zh: 当时，这是我见过的唯一一个类似的例子。

sentences.en: Someone from the construction industry, loudly speaking out about these raids.
sentences.zh: 建筑行业的人大声反对这些突袭行动。

sentences.en: So I called them.
sentences.zh: 所以我打电话给他们。

sentences.en: Hello, it's Mario.
sentences.zh: 喂，我是马里奥。

sentences.en: Hey, Mario, it's Lindsay Garrison.
sentences.zh: 嗨，马里奥，我是林赛·加里森。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time talking with me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间和我交谈。

sentences.en: I'm really grateful.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: I'm sure you're very busy.
sentences.zh: 我确信你非常忙。

sentences.en: I think busy is an understatement right now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得用“忙”来形容现在的情况简直是轻描淡写。

sentences.en: I'm running around like a headless chicken.
sentences.zh: 我忙得像只无头苍蝇。

sentences.en: Mario owns a construction company.
sentences.zh: 马里奥拥有一家建筑公司。

sentences.en: And runs the business side of his parents' construction company.
sentences.zh: 并经营着他父母的建筑公司的业务。

sentences.en: Plus, he owns a brokerage.
sentences.zh: 此外，他还拥有一家经纪公司。

sentences.en: But he's also the executive director of the South Texas Builders Association, the STBA.
sentences.zh: 但他也是南得克萨斯州建筑商协会（STBA）的执行董事。

sentences.en: It's a group of 159 construction and real estate businesses, mostly across the Rio Grande Valley.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由159家建筑和房地产企业组成的团体，主要分布在格兰德河谷。

sentences.en: So he's got a bird's eye view of things.
sentences.zh: 所以他对事情有着鸟瞰般的全局视角。

sentences.en: Right now, what is happening in the Rio Grande Valley, I mean, it's scary.
sentences.zh: 现在，格兰德河谷正在发生的事情，我的意思是，太可怕了。

sentences.en: We've had multiple builders that have been pouring driveways and, you know, immigration gets there and they just take everybody and they don't leave anyone behind.
sentences.zh: 我们有多家建筑商一直在浇筑车道，你知道，移民局的人到了，他们把所有人都带走了，不留下任何人。

sentences.en: And it's not just one or two or three builders.
sentences.zh: 而且不只是一个、两个或三个建筑商。

sentences.en: It's like more than 10 construction companies.
sentences.zh: 就像有10多家建筑公司。

sentences.en: I want to say we're up in the 1520s where it's happening more and more.
sentences.zh: 我想说我们的数字已经上升到15到20家，这种情况越来越频繁。

sentences.en: Mario told me he started noticing more and more raids in the spring of last year.
sentences.zh: 马里奥告诉我，他从去年春天开始注意到越来越多的突袭行动。

sentences.en: He started talking about it privately with other members of the STBA.
sentences.zh: 他开始与STBA的其他成员私下讨论这件事。

sentences.en: Like much of the Valley, they were also confused.
sentences.zh: 就像河谷的大多数人一样，他们也很困惑。

sentences.en: So they started using group text threads to compare notes and alert others if ICE was seen at a job site.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始使用群聊短信来核对信息，并在发现移民执法局出现在工作地点时提醒其他人。

sentences.en: But beyond that, no one initially knew what to do.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，起初没有人知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: And they felt their local leaders weren't speaking up enough about it.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得当地领导人对此发声不够。

sentences.en: So in November, Mario and the board at the STBA called a meeting for anyone in the construction community of the Valley to open up about the impact of the raids.
sentences.zh: 因此在11月，马里奥和STBA的董事会召开了一次会议，邀请河谷建筑界的任何人来公开谈论突袭行动的影响。

sentences.en: And days later, in an airy event center normally used for weddings and quinceaneras, with wrought iron chandeliers drooping from its high ceilings,
sentences.zh: 几天后，在一个通常用于婚礼和成年礼的通风良好的活动中心，其高高的天花板上垂下锻铁吊灯，

sentences.en: dozens of people from the Valley's construction industry shuffled in to share stories.
sentences.zh: 河谷建筑行业的数十人鱼贯而入，分享他们的故事。

sentences.en: It was definitely a cry for help.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是在呼救。

sentences.en: That's all it was.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: It was a cry for help.
sentences.zh: 这是一声呼救。

sentences.en: I mean, and we're still crying for help.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们仍在呼救。

sentences.en: Business in the Valley was hurting.
sentences.zh: 河谷的商业受到了伤害。

sentences.en: And they were perplexed, wondering if maybe a mistake had been made and whether they were the ones who made it.
sentences.zh: 他们感到困惑，想知道是否犯了什么错误，以及到底是不是他们自己犯的错。

sentences.en: Man, what did we do?
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们做了什么？

sentences.en: Because many, if not most of them, had voted for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为他们中的许多人，即使不是大多数，也投票给了特朗普总统。

sentences.en: What the fuck did we do?
sentences.zh: 他妈的我们到底做了什么？

sentences.en: The Rio Grande Valley isn't really a valley at all.
sentences.zh: 格兰德河谷其实根本不是一个山谷。

sentences.en: It's a mostly flat floodplain that hugs part of the Rio Grande River.
sentences.zh: 它是一个大体平坦的泛滥平原，紧邻格兰德河的一部分。

sentences.en: Desert willows dot the terrain here.
sentences.zh: 沙漠柳树点缀着这里的地形。

sentences.en: Palm trees rattle in the wind.
sentences.zh: 棕榈树在风中沙沙作响。

sentences.en: People here call it the RGV, or just the valley.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们称之为RGV，或者简称为河谷。

sentences.en: And its four counties have some of the highest Hispanic concentrations in the entire country.
sentences.zh: 它的四个县拥有全美最高的西班牙裔集中度之一。

sentences.en: Most people here slip in and out of Spanish without a second thought.
sentences.zh: 这里的大多数人切换西语和英语时甚至不需要多想。

sentences.en: As someone put it to me, it's like coming to another country between two larger ones.
sentences.zh: 正如有人对我说的那样，这就像是在两个更大的国家之间来到了另一个国家。

sentences.en: For generations, the Valley voted Democrat.
sentences.zh: 几代以来，河谷一直投票支持民主党。

sentences.en: But it's more of a purple place than a blue one.
sentences.zh: 但它与其说是一个蓝色区域，不如说是一个紫色区域。

sentences.en: It's a deeply Catholic part of the country, where attending church is a weekly rhythm.
sentences.zh: 这是该国一个天主教色彩浓厚的地方，去教堂是每周的常规节奏。

sentences.en: Most people I've talked to call themselves conservative or moderate.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的大多数人都称自己为保守派或温和派。

sentences.en: Cross-border commerce and small businesses help fuel the economy here.
sentences.zh: 跨境贸易和小企业帮助推动了这里的经济。

sentences.en: So does Border Patrol, a huge employer in the Valley.
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队也是如此，它是河谷的一个庞大雇主。

sentences.en: This close to the border, immigration is not a slogan or a platform.
sentences.zh: 如此靠近边境，移民问题不是一个口号或一个政治纲领。

sentences.en: All of the complexities and intricacies of the issue are layered on top of one another.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的所有的复杂性和错综性都层层交织在一起。

sentences.en: It's just a part of life.
sentences.zh: 这只是生活的一部分。

sentences.en: So it's the kind of place where a reverend of a small church happens to also be a Border Patrol agent preaching to his undocumented congregants.
sentences.zh: 所以这里就是这样一个地方：一个小教堂的牧师恰好也是一名边境巡逻队特工，向他没有合法身份的会众传道。

sentences.en: A place where a popular restaurant gives breakfast discounts and deals to law enforcement like ICE, even though some of the employees taking their order
sentences.zh: 一个受欢迎的餐馆为执法部门（如移民执法局）提供早餐折扣和优惠的地方，尽管一些接受他们点单的员工

sentences.en: or cooking their food in the back may not have legal status.
sentences.zh: 或者在后厨做饭的人可能没有合法身份。

sentences.en: It's all tangled up and knotted together.
sentences.zh: 这一切都纠缠在一起，结成了一个死结。

sentences.en: So when there's some big change in immigration policy nationally, it hits the Valley firSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，当国家移民政策发生一些重大变化时，它首先冲击的是河谷。

sentences.en: And it can often feel like a seismic weather event, changing the topography of a place.
sentences.zh: 它通常让人感觉像是一场地震般的天气事件，改变了一个地方的地形。

sentences.en: And in 2021, a big one came.
sentences.zh: 而在2021年，一场大风暴来了。

sentences.en: The largest immigration surge in U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国历史上最大规模的移民激增

sentences.en: history, which peaked during the Biden administration, had landed in the Rio Grande Valley.
sentences.zh: 在拜登政府期间达到顶峰，已经登陆格兰德河谷。

sentences.en: We saw it because it was happening here in our backyard.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了，因为它就发生在我们的后院。

sentences.en: We saw it.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了。

sentences.en: We saw it here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里看到了。

sentences.en: Where are the front lines?
sentences.zh: 前线在哪里？

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I remember even seeing, like, the caravans of people.
sentences.zh: 我甚至记得看到过像人群大篷车一样的东西。

sentences.en: Thousands of people were making their way to the border.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人正在前往边境的路上。

sentences.en: Daily, we would have 100 buses coming into there and out of there for almost four years.
sentences.zh: 每天，我们都有100辆巴士进进出出，持续了将近四年。

sentences.en: At one point, 10,000 immigrants a day were crossing into the United States along the southern border.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，每天有1万名移民沿南部边境进入美国。

sentences.en: You would see the border full of immigrants just laying there.
sentences.zh: 你会看到边境上到处都是躺在那里的移民。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我想，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Where are all these sounds that come into people going to?
sentences.zh: 所有人发出的这些声音都要去哪里？

sentences.en: People told me it rocked the Valley and put a strain on so many here.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我，这震动了河谷，给这里的许多人带来了压力。

sentences.en: The Border Patrol here were overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 这里的边境巡逻队不堪重负。

sentences.en: Like Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 就像边境巡逻队一样。

sentences.en: And everybody here knows Border Patrol agents.
sentences.zh: 这里的每个人都认识边境巡逻队特工。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's so many of them.
sentences.zh: 他们有太多人了。

sentences.en: You could see the stress.
sentences.zh: 你能看到那种压力。

sentences.en: Two Border Patrol agents in the Valley killed themselves in the span of a week.
sentences.zh: 河谷的两名边境巡逻特工在一周内相继自杀。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, there's more break-ins, there's more robberies.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，入室盗窃变多了，抢劫也变多了。

sentences.en: Some business owners told me they sensed a rise in crime.
sentences.zh: 一些企业主告诉我，他们感觉到犯罪率上升了。

sentences.en: I mean, I saw it as a business owner.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为一名企业主，我看到了。

sentences.en: One man told me he'd open up his hardware store to find his chain-link fence had been cut into.
sentences.zh: 一个人告诉我，他打开五金店时发现他的链条围栏被切开了。

sentences.en: A wheelbarrow had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 一辆独轮车被偷了。

sentences.en: And he assumed who took it.
sentences.zh: 他猜测是谁拿的。

sentences.en: They just die here from some random country and they need a couple bucks.
sentences.zh: 他们只是从某个随机的国家死里逃生来到这里，他们需要几块钱。

sentences.en: They need to eat.
sentences.zh: 他们需要吃东西。

sentences.en: So it's understandable, not condonable, but it's understandable.
sentences.zh: 所以这是可以理解的，虽然不能纵容，但这是可以理解的。

sentences.en: But the frustration went beyond a stolen wheelbarrow.
sentences.zh: 但这种沮丧感不仅仅是因为一台被偷的独轮车。

sentences.en: The whole situation inflamed deeply held perceptions of unfairness.
sentences.zh: 整个局势激化了人们根深蒂固的不公平感。

sentences.en: My wife's a nurse.
sentences.zh: 我妻子是一名护士。

sentences.en: There was occasions where she would say there was illegals in one of the rooms because they're pregnant and that's going to have a baby here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 有几次她说其中一个房间里有非法移民，因为他们怀孕了，要在美国生个孩子。

sentences.en: People told me they felt the new arrivals were getting preferential treatment.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我，他们觉得新来的人受到了优待。

sentences.en: And she's got a guard in the door and then she's getting all the medicines because the government's paying for it.
sentences.zh: 门口有个警卫，她能拿到所有的药，因为政府在付钱。

sentences.en: Yet I have American citizens in the next room that can't afford to have that type of care because she's a citizen.
sentences.zh: 然而隔壁房间里有美国公民，却因为她是公民而负担不起那种医疗护理。

sentences.en: And cutting the line in front of people who had been trying for months or even years to become a citizen.
sentences.zh: 而且还插队排在那些已经尝试了几个月甚至几年想要成为公民的人前面。

sentences.en: Because of all the pressure with all the refugees coming over here or the illegal aliens, whatever you want to call them, all the people that had submitted their paperwork,
sentences.zh: 由于所有涌入这里的难民或非法外国人（无论你想怎么称呼他们）带来的压力，所有提交了文件的人，

sentences.en: they don't have enough personnel to handle all this new processing.
sentences.zh: 他们没有足够的人手来处理所有这些新的审批流程。

sentences.en: Like an administrator of a local school who told me that a dean of students had a work visa that was about to expire.
sentences.zh: 就像当地一所学校的行政人员告诉我的一样，有一位学生事务长的工作签证即将过期。

sentences.en: He submitted the paperwork to renew it on time.
sentences.zh: 他按时提交了续签文件。

sentences.en: They're like, sorry, we're so backed up.
sentences.zh: 他们说，抱歉，我们积压了太多文件。

sentences.en: We haven't gotten to your file.
sentences.zh: 我们还没处理到你的档案。

sentences.en: It wasn't processed in time and it expired.
sentences.zh: 它没有按时处理，结果过期了。

sentences.en: Then you need to go back to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 然后你需要回墨西哥。

sentences.en: His lawyer advised him to return to Mexico so that he wasn't in the country illegally and jeopardizing his citizenship process.
sentences.zh: 他的律师建议他返回墨西哥，这样他就不是非法滞留在国内，也不会危及他的公民身份申请程序。

sentences.en: And so here we are, almost three years later, he still has never gotten his visa to come over.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们到了这里，大约三年过去了，他依然没有拿到来这里的签证。

sentences.en: These accounts were sometimes second and third hand and they often painted an incomplete picture.
sentences.zh: 这些说法有时是二手和三手的，它们经常描绘出一幅不完整的画面。

sentences.en: For example, according to the McAllen Police Department, property crime did rise slightly in 2022, but overall crime was actually down in the city during this period.
sentences.zh: 例如，根据麦卡伦警察局的数据，2022年财产犯罪确实略有上升，但在此期间，该市的总体犯罪率实际上是下降的。

sentences.en: And that backlog at the border, it predated the surge under Biden.
sentences.zh: 而边境的积压问题，在拜登时期的激增之前就已经存在了。

sentences.en: And while undocumented immigrants are guaranteed care in emergency medical situations, so are American citizens.
